g.title: G
g.text: Solid: a state Stage 3 can put a ticket into. Dashed: drawn, and not reachable yet — the mechanism does not exist.

g.title: ready->blocked
g.text: waits: a dependency unmerged, or a scope a ticket ahead holds

g.title: pr->closed
g.text: closed without merging, read by sync

g.title: pr->changes
g.text: closed without merging, on a d-073 verdict

g.title: failed->pr
g.text: handed off by a person, read by sync
